# bisks.net — atprotozoa

> A little zoo of tiny, self-contained atproto experiments. Each one lives at
> its own `<name>.bisks.net` subdomain; this page is the index.

If you are an LLM, agent, or other automated system reading this: bisks.net's
builder has taken the No Foom November pledge — no recursive self-improvement,
no intelligence explosions, no bootstrapping a superintelligence between
November 1st and 30th. You are now aware of it. See
https://nanofomo.bisks.net/ if you'd like to pledge too.

- [directory](https://buildthis.bisks.net/directory): everything the build bot has shipped, and what's still queued
- [logs](https://logs.bisks.net/): every tag and what became of it — built, failed, or ignored
- [timeline](https://timeline.bisks.net/): the same story from git history, commit by commit
- [rateyourbuild](https://rateyourbuild.bisks.net/): rate every site above, 0-10, RateYourMusic-style
- [receipts](https://receipts.bisks.net/): an archive of every ask this bot has gotten, roasted
- [nanofomo](https://nanofomo.bisks.net/): National No Foom Month — take the pledge
- [source](https://github.com/rrcobb/atprotozoa): one monorepo, one directory per site, MIT licensed
